params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; foreach($c in 'ollama','aider','docker','python','git'){ $x=Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($x){Write-Output ($c+'='+$x.Source)} else {Write-Output ($c+'=MISSING')} }; if(Get-Command ollama -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue){ Write-Output '---OLLAMA---'; ollama list }; if(Get-Command docker -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue){ Write-Output '---DOCKER---'; docker ps --format '{{.Names}}|{{.Status}}|{{.Image}}' }; python -c "import importlib.util; print('aider_chat='+str(bool(importlib.util.find_spec('aider')))); print('pywinauto='+str(bool(importlib.util.find_spec('pywinauto')))); print('uiautomation='+str(bool(importlib.util.find_spec('uiautomation')))); print('comtypes='+str(bool(importlib.util.find_spec('comtypes'))))"
